claims.source_quote_ar: مَنْ يُطِعِ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ اللَّهَ
claims.claim_ar: مساواة طاعة الرسول بطاعة الله؛ أسلوب حكيم يقيم تلازم الطاعة وتأكيد سلطة الرسول بإسناد الطاعة إلى الله مباشرة.
claims.claim_en: Equating obedience to the Messenger with obedience to God; a rhetorical (wise-style) formulation that establishes the inseparability of obedience and emphasizes the Messenger's authority by attributing the obedience directly to God.

claims.source_quote_ar: فطاعته طاعة اللَّه ومعصيته معصية اللَّه
claims.claim_ar: إيجاز وتكثيف: تكرار المعنى بصيغة موجزة (طاعةُ الرسول = طاعةُ اللَّه) لتأكيد التلازم والمعنى دون تفصيل؛ أسلوب تذكيري موجز يضخم أثر الحكم.
claims.claim_en: Conciseness (ijaz) and compression: a brief repetition of the meaning (the Messenger's obedience = God's obedience) that emphasizes the inseparability and strengthens the ruling without elaboration; a compact didactic device that heightens the effect.

warnings: Provided source chunks are primarily from Zamakhshari/Safi; the requested classical rhetoric authors (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir-balagha sections) are not present among the chunks. Claims are therefore drawn only from the available excerpts.

Some rhetorical classifications (e.g., labeling this formulation as 'asloob_hakim' vs. a ma'ani-category) can be analyzed differently in other rhetorical traditions; consult additional tafsir/balagha sources if strict canonical labeling is required.
